title: Microdevice renewal: retained electrical isolation and interior service access
status_authority: Supplied available rendered return and ROOT introduced contracts at exact scopes; earlier accepted source-bound results remain unchanged. No Capital scientific execution, physical qualification or new independent audit.
reported_status: P1 supplies a designed dry-contact carrier whose conductors retract independently of mechanical retention, plus detachable seven-component leaves for interior service. The visible report specifies a 56-part optical head, finite observations, tool routes, continuous simulated identities/wear and complete costs. Its final conditional campaign reaches full readiness at 24.115 hours, missing the 24-hour boundary despite earlier output, and costs more than the competent folded rigid-flex comparator. No physical manufacturing/repair, installed metrology, contact life, production yield or whole-operation advantage is established. Earlier thermal/rework models remain at their own scopes.
scientific_scope_status: P1 supplies a designed dry-contact carrier whose conductors retract independently of mechanical retention, plus detachable seven-component leaves for interior service. The visible report specifies a 56-part optical head, finite observations, tool routes, continuous simulated identities/wear and complete costs. Its final conditional campaign reaches full readiness at 24.115 hours, missing the 24-hour boundary despite earlier output, and costs more than the competent folded rigid-flex comparator. No physical manufacturing/repair, installed metrology, contact life, production yield or whole-operation advantage is established. Earlier thermal/rework models remain at their own scopes. Eight-sector optical head: 56 functional parts, 136 specified terminal-to-net joins on 43 nets, 32 submillimetre passives plus eight qualifying amplifiers, nominal complete 24.9 mm cube. Three noncoplanar layouts share component stock and a paid external instrument. Individual component ownership, electrical opening, diagnosis, tool capture, full extraction route, reconnection, installed functional proof and return-to-ready are distinct operations.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The mechanism is a design and executable route/campaign report, not a fabricated apparatus. Rigid-envelope collision screens omit some flexible wires, deflection and continuous tool motion. Maker points do not qualify custom contacts, ceramic recovery, force distribution, photodiode/LED operating point or high-impedance leakage. Probe force can alter the measured contact. The matched conventional construction receives equal geometry, access and automatic test. Neither threefold complete speed nor 30% cost improvement is achieved; proposed physical experiments are unexecuted.
